description: This file defines the Order model class within the Opencart e-commerce platform, handling database operations related to orders such as creation, updating, deletion, retrieval, and managing related entities like products, totals, options, subscriptions, and history logs.
external_files: model_checkout_order (model for order products, totals, options, subscriptions)

classes.name: Order
classes.description: Represents the order operations for creating, updating, retrieving, and deleting orders, as well as managing related entities like products, totals, options, subscriptions, and order history within the Opencart platform.

methods.name: addOrder
methods.description: Creates a new order record in the database with provided data, and adds associated products and totals.

methods.name: editOrder
methods.description: Modifies an existing order record, merging new data with old, and updating associated products and totals, including handling order status changes.

methods.name: editTransactionId
methods.description: Updates the transaction ID for a specific order.

methods.name: editOrderStatusId
methods.description: Updates the order status ID in the database.

methods.name: editComment
methods.description: Updates the comment associated with an order.

methods.name: deleteOrder
methods.description: Deletes an order and its related products, totals, histories, transactions, and rewards.

methods.name: getOrder
methods.description: Retrieves comprehensive order details, including status, products, totals, and address info.

methods.name: addProduct
methods.description: Adds a new product entry to an order, including options and subscription details if applicable.

methods.name: deleteProducts
methods.description: Removes all products associated with a specific order.

methods.name: getProduct
methods.description: Retrieves a specific product from an order.

methods.name: getProducts
methods.description: Retrieves all products associated with an order.

methods.name: addOption
methods.description: Adds an option to a product in an order.

methods.name: deleteOptions
methods.description: Removes all options for an order.

methods.name: getOptions
methods.description: Retrieves options for a product in an order.

methods.name: addSubscription
methods.description: Creates a subscription record linked to an order product.

methods.name: deleteSubscription
methods.description: Removes subscription records for an order.

methods.name: getSubscription
methods.description: Retrieves subscription details for an order product.

methods.name: getSubscriptions
methods.description: Retrieves all subscriptions for a specific order.

methods.name: getTotalOrdersBySubscriptionId
methods.description: Returns the total number of orders linked to a subscription ID.

methods.name: addTotal
methods.description: Creates a new total record for an order.

methods.name: deleteTotals
methods.description: Removes total records for an order.

methods.name: getTotals
methods.description: Retrieves all total records for an order.

methods.name: addHistory
methods.description: Adds a history entry for an order, manages status transitions, fraud checks, stock updates, and related actions.

methods.name: deleteHistories
methods.description: Deletes all history entries for an order.
